title: Positive scalar curvature and uniform codimension-two width
main_claim: For every n≥4 there is C_n such that every complete connected n-manifold with Scal≥1 has a continuous map to a simplicial complex of dimension ≤n−2 whose entire fibers have diameter ≤C_n (=4D+2). Corollaries: a filling-radius bound for closed manifolds, dim_mc of universal covers of closed PSC manifolds ≤n−2 (n≥2), and no PSC metric on closed aspherical manifolds of dimension ≥4.
coverage: Read in full: introduction, pressure law (§2), local stretching step (§3), stretching rounds (§4), finite cuts (§5), most of the countable construction (§6), the reconstruction/fiber argument (§7), the minimizer appendix sections on wall stability, seam deletion and raw domination, both shielding appendices, and the stage-margin part of the regularization appendix. Checked by hand or with sympy: (1) the exact identity E−𝓑 = sum of squares in the local step, plus the derivation of E from the foliation scalar formula (S'=lM+K/l, eχ=−mχK, trace drop θb²) and both slope regimes and their constants; (2) the round rescaling D(h/R²,t)=R²D(h,t), the start condition R0²/2≥T², and the restored coefficient L*²(1−(n+1)δ)≥1; (3) the warped-circle scalar formula, including that k=399 circles with exponent 2/(k+1) give R=R_old−(4k/(k+1))Δ_ω w/w, which matches C=3.99; (4) wall stability with Gauss, p²+2∂_νp≥.33p²−1.02Π, and the deletion/seam estimate with Young margin 2−4/3.05−.67=113/6100>0; (5) the shell profile, where ∫dy/(.29y²−y+1)=5π and the gradient identity gives .58u²+2δ⁻²; (6) the plane Hardy potentials 8−3=5 in the bulk and 2·7−8=6 on the wall, and 1.16·2.12·1.04/3.5<.78; (7) the max-of-costs concentration argument and finite termination of shielding via an increasing open cover of a compact set; (8) the regular:eta margin identities, which sympy confirms exactly; (9) the stage-0 budget .25+1.12/20<.4, the crossing length 2π√(2/p), and that c_r stays bounded because Ση_r is summable; (10) the Riccati obstruction in dimension one; (11) the count inclusions for required regions; (12) the staircase cubical map, the injectivity of coordinates, and the 4D+2 fiber bound. Not independently re-derived: the GMT compactness, generic uniqueness and end-convergence of true cuts in product ends (cut:gmt, cut:end-convergence); the moving-domain compactness proof in shield:compactness beyond its outline; the guarded regularization and the seam smoothing that turns form bounds into smooth packets; the packet-geometry appendix; and the collar compressions in the topological reconstruction. These are the deepest parts, and a gap could still be hidden there.
